items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: George Wein called me, you know, and he asked me if I would be interested in doing some gigs with him... So he hired me and Phil and a drummer to play a gig

ctx.x: At this time you couldn't stay with Duke, so what did you do then?
Well, just by chance... Who's the guy who used to work with George Wein?
